$Comment: Copy of vanilla Ability_Frost_Freeze with a status icon that exists (the vanilla UI/StatusEffects/Icon_Slow.png is missing from Assets.zip 0.7.2). Not applied while the target has AT_Ice_King_Warmth (the warmth potion). ApplyConditions are checked every tick, not only on apply (LivingEntityEffectSystem removes an active effect whose conditions fail), so drinking the potion also ends a freeze. The immunity window after a freeze (AT_Ice_King_Freeze_Guard, 2026-10-21) is checked by the attacks instead (an EffectCondition before each freeze): here it would remove the freeze the moment the guard lands. 2026-10-21 : an ice block encases the frozen player while the freeze lasts, then shatters: ModelOverride = the Ice_Block (grows out of the ground on Spawn, cracks and breaks on Despawn), drawn over the entity like the shield bubble (no collision). The ModelVFX Freeze shell stays under it. Every freeze of the fight (5th frost stack, freezing ray/iceberg/lightning, snowman hug) uses this effect. Screen effect (2026-10-21): the vanilla snow overlay ScreenEffects/Snow.png on the frozen player's screen while it lasts, the one vanilla Status/Stun uses (other vanilla overlays: Fire, Water, Poison, Sand, Immune). Ice block variants (2026-10-21: not always the same block): the Spawn set lists Ice_Block_Spawn, Ice_Block_Spawn_B (taller, twisted) and Ice_Block_Spawn_C (wide and low, top crystal tipped) with Weight 1 each; the client picks one and holds its shape while the freeze lasts. Same model and texture. More variants (2026-10-21: cool ones): the model is now Ice_Block_Variants.blockymodel = Ice_Block plus hidden extra crystals (X1-X8 tall, Y1-Y4 small) that only the new Spawn variants show: D crown of spikes on the head crystal, E burst of crystals, F glacier slabs leaning on the block, G two tall spires. Seven Spawn animations, Weight 1 each. Ice_Block.blockymodel itself is untouched (edits to it must be copied into the variants model, or rerun the ice_block_cool.py). 20 variants (2026-10-21/22: only one or two should cover him fully, one a snowman, the rest spaced chunks that let him show): Ice_Block_Variants.blockymodel (every part hidden by default, plus pools X1-X8 / Y1-Y8 / C01-C12, all animatable; the head crystal centred on a vanilla Player) with Spawn = Ice_Block_V01..V20, Weight 1 each: V01 full block, V02 full + crown of spikes, V03 snowman, V04-V20 partial (legs, feet slab, torso band, pauldrons, diagonal, arms, back spikes, head, chest burst, spiral, left / right cluster, glacier, spires, scattered, cage, chest and head). Despawn = Ice_Block_V_Despawn (empty: the pieces vanish at once; the old break animation would show the full block). Generator: the ice_block_v20.py.
